description: Get the most recently modified notes from the Obsidian vault. Use this when the user asks 'what have I been working on?', 'show me recent notes', or wants to see what changed in the last few days. Returns notes sorted by modification date.

configuration.query: FROM athena-notes | WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?time_range) | KEEP title, vault_relative_path, tags, note_type, word_count, updated_at | SORT updated_at DESC | LIMIT ?limit

time_range.description: How far back to look. Format: 'N hours'. Examples: '168 hours' for 7 days, '72 hours' for 3 days, '24 hours' for today. Default: '168 hours' (7 days).

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return. Default 10.
